verdict.rationale: The only keyboard-related first-party evidence is a ROADMAP entry for "Customizable keyboard shortcuts". That is a plan, not a shipped capability. Two community reports independently say Zero does not yet have real keyboard navigation. Nothing documents a command palette, and the note that storing emails in Durable Objects "speed[s] things up" does not show a keyboard-driven workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
